services.name: Free Yoga at the ICA
services.desc: The ICA San José is thrilled to partner with Downtown Yoga Shala for another series of free yoga classes at the ICA! Join us monthly through the summer and fall in the ICA main gallery for a 1-hour long yoga class surrounded by our rotating exhibitions. All classes through the end of 2026 will be from 5:30-6:30pm.
